Image generation requesting multiple images

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.createImageRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"dall-e-2\",\"n\":3,\"prompt\":\"A red bicycle\",\"size\":\"256x256\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.imageGenerate(request: _request)
```
